question_text: Was the FBI's NCIC crime database hacked?
answer_text: Six outlets, each citing their own unnamed sources, report an apparent hack. On Nov 24 the FBI Director, asked about it, said only that the matter is an ongoing investigation. The FBI has not said what, if anything, was reached.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: An FBI or DOJ statement confirming the intrusion and saying what it reached.

question_text: Is the FBI crime database breach linked to the FAA, NSA or other outages?
answer_text: No source connects them. The DNI said the week's outages came from system upgrades and were not coordinated; he did not link the FBI incident. No source links NCIC to the separate CIA and ODNI breach reported on Nov 24.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: An FBI, DOJ or White House statement on the NCIC intrusion that addresses the other incidents.

question_text: Was my information in the FBI crime database taken or changed?
answer_text: No source says what, if anything, was copied or changed. The FBI has said nothing, so there is no notice to act on yet.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: An FBI statement or notice saying what data was reached.

question_text: Is this the same as the September FBI jobs-site hack?
answer_text: CNN reports it as a separate, second breach. The September breach hit the FBI jobs portal, and no source links the two.
label: Reported

question_text: Is NCIC still working for police?
what_would_settle_it: An FBI statement, or reporting from police agencies, on whether NCIC service was interrupted.
